evals.prompt: Our Cypress tests are flaky because of cy.wait(3000). Help us fix the test suite for the checkout flow.
evals.expected_output: A plan and code that replaces fixed waits with condition-based waits and network control, uses accessible queries, and quarantines remaining flakes with owners.
expectations: Removes fixed sleeps in favor of waiting for conditions
Controls network with intercepts or mocks
Uses role or label based selectors
Defines a quarantine process with owner
